description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreClient' for the client-side UI of a career exploration app. It manages search, filtering, and displaying role recommendations either as cards or a mind map, including fetching options and search results from APIs.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an input value to a trimmed string, handling nullish values gracefully.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input to an array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range fields from role objects to determine minimum and maximum salary in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the role title from a role object.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches the current filter criteria, including industry, skills, salary range, and title query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React functional component managing the career explore UI, including search, filters, and displaying role recommendations.
